hard_limits._note: Layer 1. Fixed, never learned. implausible -> ARTIFACT (auto recheck, no page). danger -> ABSOLUTE regardless of baseline (goals of care still apply).

population_defaults._note: Conservative bands used during learning and as the fallback when a stratum has too few samples. Outside the band during learning -> CONFIRM_FIRST (confirm-first widened).

learning._note: Layer 2. Per-patient onboarding window. Baselines per vital x activity_state x time_of_day.

confirm_widening._note: During learning, at_patient_baseline suppression is not allowed (unless clinician_set_baseline). Outside the population band -> CONFIRM_FIRST.

adaptation._note: Layer 3. Rolling robust baseline (weighted median / MAD) with bounds, condition-change resets and a drift guard.

learn_bounds._note: A learned baseline median is clamped inside these bounds (always inside the hard limits); every clamp is logged.

condition_change._note: Partial reset: older samples of the affected vitals keep retain_weight, and a shortened learning period is re-entered. Constraint (validated): relearn_days > retain_weight x rolling_window_days, so that after relearning the new data outweigh a full window of old data.

drift_guard._note: A slow monotonic drift toward abnormal is NOT learned. It is flagged SUBTLE_DETERIORATION_TREND for review, and the drifting samples are excluded from the baseline. Total change = mean of the last k daily rest medians minus the first k in the window (k<=3); samples from the window start onward are excluded once the drift flag is raised (conservative).

unanswered_prompt._note: DECIDED RULE (Wayne 2026-10-17, ST2-009): an unanswered patient-directed confirm prompt (patient call or watch tap-to-confirm) when the patient lives alone counts as a FAILED confirm -> escalate now (confirm_step already_confirmed). Not living alone -> wait for the timeout as before. Caregiver pings are not patient prompts.

chest_pain._note: HT_CHEST_PAIN_VITALS is a parametric rule, replacing the flat 10-min CONFIRM_FIRST, which the clinical owner rejected. ALL VALUES ARE PLACEHOLDERS. Order: hard limits (implausible -> recheck, danger -> ABSOLUTE) -> reliable ECG change -> ABSOLUTE -> per-vital band -> side-specific context modifiers -> symptom modifiers -> safety floors -> band -> output.

vital_bands._note: With chest pain present, population rest thresholds. high: value >= threshold; low: value <= threshold.

modifiers._note: Band shifts: -1 = one band less severe, +1 = one band more severe. Side-specific: *_low applies only when the vital is on its low side, *_high only on its high side.

pacemaker._note: HR at or above the programmed lower rate (within 2 bpm) -> the HR is not banded; below the lower rate -> +1 (possible pacing failure).

known_brady._note: documented usual low HR range; applies when the HR is within the range minus 3 bpm

known_tachy._note: documented usual high HR (e.g. rate-controlled AF); applies when the HR is within the range max + 10 bpm

concordance._note: discordant may only lower band B or C; it never lowers A

device_reliability._note: A quality-flagged vital is not banded and the output becomes a recheck (CONFIRM_FIRST device_recheck) unless the reliable inputs already give band A.

safety._note: Context can lower a raw band by at most 2 and can never turn raw band A into log-only. Hard danger limits (HT_VS_DANGER) and a reliable ECG change are always ABSOLUTE (goals of care still apply).

crescendo_rule._note: DECIDED RULE (not a placeholder decision): a crescendo angina pattern (episodes becoming more frequent, or new onset in recent days) with normal vitals triggers HT_CHEST_PAIN_VITALS CONFIRM_FIRST (band C at least). min_band and the timeout remain placeholder values. With normal vitals the post-exertion timeout factor is not applied, because the trigger is the pattern.

drug_low_floor._note: FOUNDATION (hard floor). A confirmed (meter at/below glucose_confirm_max, or two sensor readings at/below the danger limit) AND symptomatic danger-level low on insulin or a sulfonylurea -> HT_DRUG_LOW ABSOLUTE urgent_page. Applies in hospice (escalation_target hospice_nurse) and regardless of CKD. Never suppressed by goals of care, a setting profile or a patient override (foundation=true). Rationale (Wayne): a drug-induced low is harm, not comfort care.

ckd_low_dose_review._note: Insulin or sulfonylurea + CKD, danger-level CGM low cleared by a normal recheck, no symptoms and no documented sensor compression -> SUPPRESSED ckd_low_dose_review, provider_task (prescriber dose review), HITM flag kept. With documented compression the v1.10 nurse_task HITM floor still applies. Without CKD: a single low cleared by an untreated normal recheck stays silent_log; a prior danger-level low in the last 7 days (pattern) -> repeated_lows_dose_review provider_task.

patient_band._note: Patient-level SpO2 band documented in advance (e.g. COPD 'usual resting SpO2 86-88%'). A reliable resting reading inside the band does not fire HT_SPO2_LT88 (SUPPRESSED within_patient_band, silent_log). A reading below the band is NOT baseline: the band's lower bound replaces night minimums as own baseline. Outside hospice, a confirmed SpO2 below copd_urgent_below in COPD -> CONFIRM_FIRST already_confirmed -> urgent_page (pulmonary hypertension / demand ischaemia).

impact_inactivity_cap._note: On an anticoagulant, an on-wrist impact + inactivity >= fall_v1102.inactivity_min is capped at nurse_task (SUPPRESSED possible_fall_unverified) unless a confirmed fall, pain after a fall, or a head strike is documented. An unanswered check prompt is not capped (safety exception, kept from v1.10). The cap does not apply (v1.10.2 behaviour kept) when inactivity lasts >= long_inactivity_min (PLACEHOLDER) or the patient lives alone with dementia/cognitive impairment (a denial is not a reliable check).
impact_inactivity_cap.head_strike_rx: (?:hit|banged|bumped|struck|knocked|cut) (?:his|her|the back of (?:his|her)) head|head (?:strike|injury|wound|knock)|bleeding from (?:his|her|the) (?:head|scalp)|(?:lump|bump|gash) on (?:his|her) head

device_ticket._note: Device disagreement / likely device fault with a stable patient (no symptoms, no ABSOLUTE or CONFIRM_FIRST trigger): clinical route silent_log + a non-interruptive device_ticket. Ticket types: device_maintenance (default; routed to the device-maintenance process, else whoever can check the device), supply_reference_oximeter_and_baseline (SpO2 disagreement with no fingertip oximeter on the device list), ecg_strip_request (rhythm disagreement). EXCEPTION: if the disagreement could change care (HR disagreement after a rate-drug start/increase) -> nurse_task (manual pulse) + device_maintenance ticket. Wrist-vs-finger SpO2 differences within spo2_wrist_finger_variance_points are accepted (cold hands, device differences). PLACEHOLDERS: spo2_wrist_finger_variance_points, spo2_device_variance_points, hr_disagree_bpm.

plain_reason._note: Every routed alert (nurse_task, provider_task, urgent_page) carries a short plain_reason saying why it was routed that way, written for the receiver (Wayne: 'recently discharged HF patient not wearing his device, not a broken device'). Layer 1 templates per rule/reason; Jev-owned routes get a model-routed reason naming the strongest context facts.

serotonergic_confusion._note: CANDIDATE (disabled by default, enabled=false). New confusion on a serotonergic combination (e.g. tramadol + SSRI/SNRI) after a recent start: urgent_page if the patient is currently more confused than baseline, else provider_task. Conditional ruling pattern (Wayne 2026-10-23). The 'currently more confused' read needs a live check, so it stays a candidate until reviewed.

v1111._note: SMART_TRIGGERS v1.11.1 (Wayne 2026-10-23 rulings on HO2-007, HV3-004, HV3-005, HW4-002, HW2-006, HW3-007). Every number is a PLACEHOLDER for the clinical owner. Built on synthetic practice vignettes (jev_baseline/test_layer1_v1111.py), never on holdout text.

ckd_low_explained._note: Insulin/sulfonylurea + CKD danger-level low, normal recheck, no symptoms: explained by sensor compression (witness or artifact flag) -> ckd_low_compression_explained nurse_task (check sensor placement, confirm no symptoms); explained by recent exertion -> ckd_low_exertion_explained nurse_task (exercise-precaution teaching). A prior danger low within ckd_low_dose_review.prior_low_days overrides both -> repeated_lows_dose_review provider_task. Unexplained -> ckd_low_dose_review provider_task.

glucose_lookback._note: A recovered, asymptomatic drug-related CKD danger low earlier than Day -1 but within lookback_h (PLACEHOLDER 72 h = Day -3..-2) -> recent_ckd_low_dose_review provider_task (same explanations apply).

band_no_home_o2._note: COPD reading inside a documented patient band, but the band (lower bound) or the night minimum sits at/below band_low_max with NO home oxygen on the med/device/problem list -> within_band_low_no_home_o2 provider_task (evaluate for home oxygen). With home oxygen the reading stays within_patient_band silent_log.

gap_contact._note: A contact sentence may carry its 'looked fine / well' detail in the next sentence of the same note (e.g. 'We did a video call on Day -1 at 17:00. He looked fine.')
